title: Rotate handles: owed items after #2185 (start angle, end-on ring, full-turn step, pivot at release)

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:medium
labels.description: One module or crate, a known pattern (issue-worker-medium)

body:
Found by the review of PR #2185 (merged, 385a23a15), comment 6978827195. Each item below needs a fix with a test, or a recorded decision.

- `crates/ui/src/turn_drag.rs`, `ring_hit`: The fallback start angle comes from the position of the point in the projected ring. Ring points behind the camera are dropped. The position can give a wrong angle, so the first motion can jump. Compute the angle from the point itself.
- A ring within 3 degrees of end-on shows the grab cursor. Each motion holds, so the ring never turns. Do not offer the grab for such a ring. Or show a hint that says why.
- A drag of exactly 360 degrees passes the minimum-turn check. It records an undo step with no visible change. Reduce the turn modulo 360 degrees before the check.
- The preview turns about the centre taken at press. The release uses the centre at release time. The two differ if the pose changes during the drag, for example Ctrl+Z with the button held. Use the press centre for the command. Or cancel the drag when the pose changes.
- No layout test names the Rotate button. The bar buttons have no AccessKit nodes. Add the nodes and the test.
- `viewport_bar.rs` has 419 lines. The limit is about 400 lines. Split the file along its domain seam.
- Optional: MCP has no verb to turn about the part centre. An agent must compute the pivot for `move_model` itself. Consider a verb for this.

Done means: each item above is fixed with a pinning test, or has a decision recorded in `docs/decisions/`.
